hero.title: Strategic Advisory for Business, Investment, and Transaction Decisions
hero.summary: Helping business owners, investors, attorneys, stakeholders, and organizations evaluate opportunities, risks, transactions, and growth strategies through independent analysis and practical recommendations.

items.label: Transactions
items.value: Due diligence, M&A review, and asset context

overview: LeCrown Development provides strategic advisory services designed to support critical business, investment, operational, and transaction-related decisions.
Our approach combines business analysis, economic assessment, technology expertise, operational review, and market research to provide stakeholders with actionable insights and recommendations.

serviceAreas.title: Corporate Consulting
serviceAreas.text: Support for organizations facing growth, restructuring, operational, technology, or strategic challenges.

serviceAreas.title: Business Evaluation & Assessment
serviceAreas.text: Independent analysis designed to help stakeholders understand business performance, opportunities, and risks.

serviceAreas.title: Economics Consulting
serviceAreas.text: Analytical support for organizations requiring economic, market, and investment insights.

serviceAreas.title: Mergers & Acquisitions Advisory
serviceAreas.text: Support throughout acquisition, disposition, and transaction evaluation efforts.

serviceAreas.title: Due Diligence & Transaction Support
serviceAreas.text: Independent review and analysis of business and asset information during transactions.

serviceAreas.title: Property & Asset Evaluation
serviceAreas.text: Strategic evaluation services for commercial and investment assets.
serviceAreas.disclaimer: This service provides advisory evaluations and strategic assessments. It is not represented as a licensed appraisal service where formal appraisals are legally required.

process.title: Initial Consultation
process.text: Clarify the decision, stakeholders, timeline, and desired outcome.

process.title: Information Gathering
process.text: Collect documents, financial context, operational details, and market inputs.

process.title: Research & Analysis
process.text: Evaluate risks, opportunities, assumptions, economics, and practical constraints.

process.title: Recommendations & Deliverables
process.text: Provide findings, recommendations, and next-step options matched to the engagement.

pricing.title: Engagements are customized.
pricing.text: Engagements are customized based on scope, complexity, and objectives. Contact us for a consultation and proposal.

form.heading: Request Consultation
form.description: Share the decision, transaction, asset, or business question you need evaluated.

cta.title: Need an independent view before the next decision?
cta.description: Start with the business question, transaction context, and timeline. Pricing and scope can be discussed privately.
